proposed_widenings.name: SavingThrowSourceFilter.spell
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit's passive benefit is narrower than the existing saving-throw source filter. The current surface can encode advantage against spells and other magical effects, but not spells only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells."

notes: The magic-item kind and composite passive + triggered-reaction family fit overall, and the reaction half matches existing trigger/effect shapes. I did not author content because the passive rider cannot be encoded honestly without broadening it beyond the SRD text.
